{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Vbiquetaries or Brentiani.}}Therfore it is to much vnfaithfulnes, by rules of place to embarre Chri{{ls}}t of his wil or wi{{ls}}edom to be in the Sacrament how him {{ls}}elf li{{ls}}t, and on as many altars or places as he liketh.
